Stated Claim / Post Context:
Gunman on the run after man is shot dead on Melbourne street

Homicide detectives are treating the man's death in Melbourne's north as suspicious.

Actual Article Body:
By KYLIE STEVENS, SENIOR BREAKING NEWS REPORTER, AUSTRALIA

Published:  08:34 AEDT, 28 October 2026   |  Updated:  09:20 AEDT, 28 October 2026

An urgent police manhunt is underway after a man was gunned down and killed in Melbourne's north in a suspected targeted attack.

Emergency services were called to Mahoneys Road in Reservoir shortly before midnight on Tuesday following reports a man had been shot outside a home.

Nearby CCTV of the busy road captured the moment a volley of bullets was fired.

The man, who has not yet been formally identified, could not be revived at the scene.

Homicide detectives are treating the man's death as suspicious.

'At this stage, police are investigating if the incident was targeted,' a statement read.

'The investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident remains ongoing.'

Channel Nine's Today show reporter Christine Ahern told 3AW on Wednesday that the shooting had the hallmarks of an underworld hit.

A homicide investigation is underway after a man was shot dead in Melbourne's north

The man was killed in a suspected targeted attack

A burnt-out car was found 3km away on Robinvale Ave in Thomastown a short time later

Detectives are also investigating whether the shooting is linked to a burnt-out car found 3km away on Robinvale Ave in Thomastown a short time later.

It is understood the offenders who set the vehicle alight fled the scene in a white car.

Police spent much of the night examining the crime scenes.

Mahoneys Road was closed in both directions overnight but has since re-opened.

The gunman remains on the run.

It was the fifth shooting in Melbourne within the last fortnight.

Anyone with information or relevant footage is urged to contact Crime Stoppers.

Do you know more? Email tips@dailymail.com.au .
